mapper.select: SELECT object_limit_bytes,reserved_bytes,committed_bytes,version,status FROM pf.space_storage WHERE space_id=#{space} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.space_storage SET reserved_bytes=reserved_bytes+#{bytes},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{space} AND status='ACTIVE' AND #{bytes}<=object_limit_bytes-reserved_bytes-committed_bytes
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.upload_session u JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.space_id=u.space_id AND a.id=u.asset_id WHERE u.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND u.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND u.request_id=#{request}
SELECT FROM pf.upload_session u JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.space_id=u.space_id AND a.id=u.asset_id WHERE u.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM pf.upload_session u JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.space_id=u.space_id AND a.id=u.asset_id WHERE u.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF u
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='UPLOADING',transfer_owner=#{owner},transfer_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CREATED' AND expires_at>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='VERIFIED',transfer_owner=NULL,transfer_until=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND transfer_owner=#{owner} AND transfer_until>clock_timestamp()
UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='VERIFYING',transfer_owner=NULL,transfer_until=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND transfer_owner=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.file_entry f LEFT JOIN pf.file_version v ON v.space_id=f.space_id AND v.id=f.current_version_id WHERE f.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM pf.file_entry f LEFT JOIN pf.file_version v ON v.space_id=f.space_id AND v.id=f.current_version_id WHERE f.space_id=#{space} AND f.workspace_id=#{workspace} AND f.relative_path=#{path}

SELECT FROM pf.file_entry f LEFT JOIN pf.file_version v ON v.space_id=f.space_id AND v.id=f.current_version_id WHERE f.space_id=#{space} AND f.workspace_id=#{workspace} AND f.parent_path=#{parent} AND f.relative_path>#{after} ORDER BY f.relative_path LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.id,v.space_id,v.workspace_id,v.file_id,v.asset_id,a.object_key,v.sha256,v.size_bytes,a.mime,v.created_at FROM pf.file_version v JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.space_id=v.space_id AND a.id=v.asset_id AND a.status='AVAILABLE' WHERE v.space_id=#{space} AND v.file_id=#{file} AND v.id=#{version}

SELECT s.object_limit_bytes,s.reserved_bytes,s.committed_bytes,w.quota_bytes AS workspace_quota_bytes,w.quota_inodes AS workspace_quota_inodes,NULL::bigint AS measured_bytes,NULL::bigint AS measured_inodes,NULL::timestamptz AS measured_at FROM pf.workspace w JOIN pf.space_storage s ON s.space_id=w.space_id WHERE w.space_id=#{space} AND w.id=#{workspace}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='QUEUED',operation_id=#{operation},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='VERIFIED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.file_operation WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_file_lease(workspace_id,space_id) VALUES(#{workspace},#{space}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id,space_id,operation_id,owner_id,fence,lease_until,status FROM pf.workspace_file_lease WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace} AND space_id=#{space} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_use WHERE workspace_id=#{workspace} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN'))
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_file_lease SET operation_id=#{row.id},owner_id=#{owner},fence=#{fence},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',status='ACTIVE' WHERE space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{row.workspaceId} AND status='FREE' AND fence=#{fence}-1

UPDATE pf.file_operation SET status='CLAIMED',owner_id=#{owner},fence=#{fence},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',deadline_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: WITH picked AS (SELECT id FROM pf.file_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' OR(status='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 8) UPDATE pf.file_outbox o SET status='PUBLISHING',relay_owner=#{owner},relay_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '10 seconds' FROM picked WHERE o.id=picked.id RETURNING o.id,o.operation_id,o.space_id,o.workspace_id,o.generation,o.relay_owner
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.file_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED''PENDING',relay_owner=NULL,relay_until=NULL WHERE id=#{item.id} AND operation_id=#{item.operationId} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND relay_owner=#{item.relayOwner} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_outbox WHERE id=#{item.id} AND operation_id=#{item.operationId} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND space_id=#{item.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{item.workspaceId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.file_inbox(event_id,operation_id) VALUES(#{item.id},#{item.operationId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

UPDATE pf.workspace_file_lease SET lease_until=LEAST(#{command.operation.deadlineAt},clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds') WHERE space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND owner_id=#{command.operation.ownerId} AND fence=#{command.operation.fence} AND status='ACTIVE' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE pf.workspace_file_lease SET status='BLOCKED' WHERE space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND owner_id=#{command.operation.ownerId} AND fence=#{command.operation.fence} AND status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE pf.file_entry SET current_version_id=#{row.versionId},collection_state='CONFIRMED',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.fileId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{row.workspaceId} AND current_version_id=#{row.baseVersionId} AND revision=#{row.expectedRevision} AND current_version_id IS NULL AND revision=1

UPDATE pf.asset_object SET status='AVAILABLE',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.assetId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND version_id=#{row.versionId} AND sha256=#{row.sha256} AND size_bytes=#{row.sizeBytes} AND status='STAGING'
UPDATE pf.object_reservation SET status='COMMITTED',revision=revision+1 WHERE upload_id=#{row.id} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND bytes=#{row.sizeBytes} AND status='RESERVED'

UPDATE pf.space_storage SET reserved_bytes=reserved_bytes-#{row.sizeBytes},committed_bytes=committed_bytes+#{row.sizeBytes},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND reserved_bytes>=#{row.sizeBytes}
UPDATE pf.upload_session SET status='COMMITTED',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.id} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND status='QUEUED'
UPDATE pf.file_operation SET status='COMMITTED',effect_state='CONFIRMED',revision=revision+1 WHERE
